blocks.text: If you have been reading my entertainment column here since its inception, you know that I hold a deep, unwavering reverence for the foundational pillars of pop culture. When my previous entertainment article, “Godzilla: The Titan of Franchises in Hollywood,” was posted exclusively on this website on April 4, 2024, I noted how the box-office triumph of “Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire” proved that the radioactive colossus remains as relevant as ever. Yet, as the years march on, it becomes increasingly clear that Godzilla is no longer just a movie monster. He has evolved into a multi-generational cultural institution—a cinematic force […]...
